hypothesis: The compact midpoint package is prize-facing only if every required LibNC runtime component has OSI-licensed source or explicit written contest acceptance; bundled libnc.so alone is insufficient evidence.
interfaces_exposed: Compact NNCP package -> runtime dependency/source-license census -> prize-facing or teacher-only eligibility verdict
kill_condition: If required LibNC source is absent and no written exception exists, classify all LibNC NNCP archives and package forecasts as teacher-only with zero prize-facing score credit.
promotion_condition: Pass only if the package contains complete buildable OSI-licensed source for NNCP and LibNC, or a receipt-bound written committee exception covering the exact bundled library.
retired_neighborhoods: Do not shrink or re-zip a closed binary dependency to manufacture source eligibility.
title: NNCP LibNC open-source eligibility audit
